transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... student health made me come. I was trying to get cleared for these youth workshops, but they wouldn't sign off. They said my weight is too low... and I guess the number has kept dropping, but... I don't know. To me, it just feels like what happens when I'm really focused and busy. I didn't really think I needed to be here.
Have you been worried about gaining weight or noticing changes in how you perceive your body shape or size?

I mean... I guess I worry about it a little. It's just... if I gain weight, even just a pound, it feels... bad. Like I'm losing control. If I eat a regular dinner, or something heavy, I just feel like... like it's obvious to everyone. Like they can tell I'm not trying anymore.
Have you ever made yourself vomit, exercised excessively, or used laxatives or diet pills to try to control your weight?
Um... no. I don't do any of that. I've never made myself sick or taken pills or anything. And I don't really exercise that much either... so, no.
Has your low weight or fear of gaining weight happened even when you weren't dealing with any other major stress, illness, or life changes?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... it's just always kind of like this. I haven't really had any major illnesses or anything... so, I don't know. I haven't really thought about it.

Has this fear of gaining weight or being upset about your weight or body shape been something that’s always on your mind, even when things in your life are going smoothly and you’re not particularly stressed?
Um... like I said, I'm not really sure. I guess it doesn't really matter if things are going fine or not. It's just... always there, I guess. I don't really pay attention to it like that.
Do you restrict your food intake—like skipping meals, eating very small portions, or avoiding certain foods—especially if you're worried about gaining weight?

Um... I guess I just have a routine. I kind of... plan my day around it, I guess. Like, I'll usually just have coffee before studio. And then... maybe a few bites of something from the café later, mostly just if people are watching me. But I definitely don't eat bread... or anything oily. It just... I don't know. It feels like eating that stuff would just undo the control I've worked for. So... yeah. I guess I do avoid things.
Even during times when your life is stable and you're not under any particular stress, do you still find yourself preoccupied with fears about gaining weight or concerns about your body shape?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It doesn't really go away. Just... even the thought of gaining a pound makes me panic. Like... if I were to eat a normal dinner, or... I don't know, something with butter in it... it just feels like everyone would instantly be able to see that I've lost my discipline. So... yeah. It's always there.
Even though your weight is quite low, do you still feel like you need to lose more weight or worry that you might gain weight?

Um... I think I just said that. But... yeah. Even if someone says I'm small, I just... I can't risk it. Like I told you, if I gain even a pound... if I eat something normal... it just feels like everyone will know I gave up. So... I just have to keep going.

Even when you're not actively controlling your food intake or following your routine, do you still feel like your body shape or weight is something you're intensely worried about or feel negatively toward?

Um... yeah. I guess. Like... recently we had this showcase at school, and... when I look at the photos from it, I don't really even look at the artwork. I just... I zoom in on my arms. And my waist. 

If I look... small enough in them, then I feel like... I don't know. Like I'm serious. Like I'm put-together. But... yeah. It's always there.
Even when you're not actively skipping meals or following your routine, do you still feel intense fear about gaining weight or feel negatively about your body shape?
I... I don't really know what else to tell you. You keep asking me the exact same thing. Yes, I'm always worried about it. I just... I don't have a different answer for you.
